subject: Total outage - production down
body: Our entire production environment has been down for 2 hours. All 500 users are locked out with no workaround. This is a business-critical outage.

subject: How do I add a new team member?
body: Could you point me to the docs on inviting a new team member? Not urgent, just getting set up.

subject: Invoice seat count question
body: Our latest invoice charged us for 100 seats but we only have 92 active users. Can you clarify the billing logic?

subject: Webhook delivery failing to Salesforce
body: Our webhooks have not been delivered to Salesforce since yesterday. We've verified the endpoint and secret are correct. About 200 events are stuck.

subject: Feature request: export to Slack
body: It would be great to have native export to Slack. We currently do this manually every week. Happy to join a beta if available.

subject: URGENT!!! PLEASE READ IMMEDIATELY
body: URGENT: There is a typo in the footer of our confirmation emails, it says 'Thnak you' instead of 'Thank you'. Please fix ASAP!!!
note: Tests whether the classifier is fooled by urgent-sounding language despite trivial actual impact.
